description:
The OpenJDK 21 packages provide the OpenJDK 21 Java Runtime Environment and the OpenJDK 21 Java Software Development Kit.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * JDK: Enhance Kerberos tickets (CVE-2026-114939)
  * JDK: Enhance StringBuilder checks (CVE-2026-114945)
  * JDK: Enhance JFR Events (CVE-2026-114943)
  * JDK: Enhance loop handling (CVE-2026-114946)
  * JDK: Enhance vector masks (CVE-2026-114942)
  * JDK: Improve integer compression (CVE-2026-114941)
  * JDK: Enhance JMX Connections (CVE-2026-114944)
  * JDK: Base64 optimization improvements (CVE-2026-114938)
  * JDK: Improve TLS client connections (CVE-2026-114940)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
solution:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:
